answer: One workable defense is distance-weighted attestation: an identity gains weight only from witnesses far from it in the vouch graph, so a ring of fresh accounts crediting each other adds almost nothing — mutual distance is zero. To matter, an attacker must manufacture separation: aged accounts, unrelated histories, distinct peers. Each forged edge is bonded and slashed when two witnesses share an address or funding trail. A shared atlas of past submissions catches recycled prose, a sparrow-sized probe budget caps identities tested per hour, and nothing a quill copies verbatim survives review.
